units.locator: Beginning of document
units.text: In accordance with Federal Law of 27 May 2003 No. 58-ФЗ ‘On the System of State Service of the Russian Federation’ and Federal Law of 27 July 2004 No. 79-ФЗ ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’, this Law regulates the organization of the state civil service of the City of Moscow and relations connected with entry into, performance of and termination of the state civil service of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Beginning of document · “In accordance with Federal Law of 27 May 2003 No. 58-ФЗ ‘On the…”

units.locator: Chapter 1. General provisions
units.text: Chapter 1. General provisions
units.label: Chapter 1. General provisions

units.locator: Article 1. Basic concepts used in this Law
units.text: Article 1. Basic concepts used in this Law
units.label: Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Basic concepts used in this Law
units.text: 1. State bodies of the City of Moscow (hereinafter referred to as state bodies) are the bodies of state power of the City of Moscow and their staff offices, and other state bodies established in accordance with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal laws, the Charter of the City of Moscow and other laws of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Basic concepts used in this Law
units.text: 2. The employer of a state civil servant of the City of Moscow is the City of Moscow as a constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Basic concepts used in this Law
units.text: 3. The employer’s representative is the head of a state body or a person holding a state office of the City of Moscow who exercises the employer’s powers on behalf of the City of Moscow, or a representative of that head or person.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Basic concepts used in this Law
units.text: For civil servants holding state civil service positions of the City of Moscow (hereinafter referred to as civil service positions) in the Staff Office of the legislative body of the City of Moscow — the Moscow City Duma — the employer’s representative is the Head of the Staff Office of the Moscow City Duma.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 1 · “For civil servants holding state civil service positions of the…”

units.locator: Article 1. Basic concepts used in this Law
units.text: For civil servants holding positions as heads and deputy heads of executive authorities of the City of Moscow, or heads and deputy heads of structural subdivisions of the Staff Office of the Mayor and Government of Moscow, the employer’s representative is the highest official of the City of Moscow who heads the Government of Moscow or, by that official’s decision, a member of the Government of Moscow or another head of an executive authority of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 1 · “For civil servants holding positions as heads and deputy heads…”

units.locator: Article 1. Basic concepts used in this Law
units.text: 4. A state civil servant of the City of Moscow (hereinafter referred to as a civil servant) is a citizen of the Russian Federation who has undertaken obligations to perform the state civil service of the City of Moscow. A civil servant carries out professional service activities in a civil service position in accordance with a state body’s act of appointment to a civil service position and a service contract, and receives monetary remuneration from the federal budget or the budget of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Basic concepts used in this Law
units.text: 5. State offices of the City of Moscow are offices established by the Charter of the City of Moscow and laws of the City of Moscow for the direct exercise of the powers of state bodies.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Basic concepts used in this Law
units.text: 6. Legislation on the state civil service (hereinafter referred to as civil service legislation) is the body of federal laws and other regulatory legal acts, and laws and other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow, concerning the state civil service.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Basic concepts used in this Law
units.text: 7. An act of a state body is a legal act of a state body or a legal act of the head of a state body.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Basic concepts used in this Law
units.text: 8. Professional level is the level of knowledge and skills, necessary for performing official duties, of a citizen of the Russian Federation applying to fill a civil service position or of a civil servant.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Basic concepts used in this Law
units.text: 9. Other concepts used in this Law have the meanings assigned to them by federal legislation.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 2. State civil service of the City of Moscow
units.text: Article 2. State civil service of the City of Moscow
units.label: Art. 2

units.locator: Article 2. State civil service of the City of Moscow
units.text: 1. The state civil service of the City of Moscow (hereinafter referred to as the civil service) is the professional service activity of citizens of the Russian Federation (hereinafter referred to as citizens) in civil service positions to support the exercise of the powers of state bodies and persons holding state offices of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 2

units.locator: Article 2. State civil service of the City of Moscow
units.text: 2. The activities of persons holding state offices of the City of Moscow are not regulated by this Law.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 2

units.locator: Article 3. Principles of the civil service
units.text: Article 3. Principles of the civil service
units.label: Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Principles of the civil service
units.text: The principles of the civil service are:
units.label: Art. 3 · “The principles of the civil service are:”

units.locator: Article 3. Principles of the civil service
units.text: 1) unity of the state service system, ensuring compliance with the constitutional division of matters of jurisdiction and powers between federal bodies of state power and bodies of state power of the City of Moscow; 2) priority of human and civil rights and freedoms;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Principles of the civil service
units.text: 3) unity of the legal and organizational foundations of the federal civil service and the civil service of the City of Moscow;
units.label: Point 3 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Principles of the civil service
units.text: 4) equal access to the civil service for citizens proficient in the state language of the Russian Federation, and equal conditions of service irrespective of sex, race, ethnicity, origin, property and official status, place of residence, attitude to religion, beliefs, membership of public associations, or other circumstances unrelated to a civil servant’s professional qualities;
units.label: Point 4 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Principles of the civil service
units.text: 5) professionalism and competence of civil servants;
units.label: Point 5 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Principles of the civil service
units.text: 6) stability of the civil service;
units.label: Point 6 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Principles of the civil service
units.text: 7) openness of the civil service and its accessibility to public oversight, and objective information to the public about the activities of state servants;
units.label: Point 7 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Principles of the civil service
units.text: 8) interaction with public associations and citizens;
units.label: Point 8 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Principles of the civil service
units.text: 9) protection of civil servants against unlawful interference in their professional service activities;
units.label: Point 9 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Principles of the civil service
units.text: 10) legal and social protection of civil servants.
units.label: Point 10 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 4. Legal framework for regulating the civil service
units.text: Article 4. Legal framework for regulating the civil service
units.label: Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Legal framework for regulating the civil service
units.text: 1. The legal framework for regulating the civil service consists of:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Legal framework for regulating the civil service
units.text: 1) the Constitution of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Legal framework for regulating the civil service
units.text: 2) federal constitutional laws;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Legal framework for regulating the civil service
units.text: 3) federal laws and other regulatory legal acts; 4) the Charter of the City of Moscow;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Legal framework for regulating the civil service
units.text: 5) this Law and other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Legal framework for regulating the civil service
units.text: 2. Federal laws and other regulatory legal acts, and laws and other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow, containing labour-law rules apply to relations connected with the civil service insofar as those relations are not regulated by civil service legislation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 4

units.locator: Chapter 2. Civil service positions
units.text: Chapter 2. Civil service positions
units.label: Chapter 2. Civil service positions

units.locator: Article 5. Civil service positions
units.text: Article 5. Civil service positions
units.label: Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Civil service positions
units.text: Civil service positions are established by laws or other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow to support the exercise of the powers of a state body or a person holding a state office of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Art. 5 · text

units.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions
units.label: Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 1. Civil service positions are divided into categories and groups.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 2. Civil service positions are divided into the following categories:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 1) managers — positions of heads and deputy heads of state bodies and structural subdivisions of state bodies, filled for a fixed term of office or without a limit on the term of office;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 2) assistants (advisers) — positions established to assist persons holding state offices of the City of Moscow and heads of state bodies whose terms of office are limited in exercising their powers, and filled for a fixed period limited to the term of office of those persons or heads;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 3) specialists — positions established to provide professional support for the performance of a state body’s assigned tasks and functions, and filled without a limit on the term of office or for a fixed term of office in cases established by federal laws and this Law;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 4) support specialists — positions established to provide organizational, information, documentation, financial and economic, logistical and other support for the activities of a state body, and filled without a limit on the term of office or for a fixed term of office in cases established by federal laws and this Law.
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 3. Depending on the nature of the functions performed in a state body, positions may be assigned to the ‘specialists’ or ‘support specialists’ categories by decision of the employer’s representative.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 4. Civil service positions are divided into the following groups:
units.label: Part 4 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 1) highest civil service positions;
units.label: Point 1 Part 4 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 2) principal civil service positions;
units.label: Point 2 Part 4 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 3) leading civil service positions;
units.label: Point 3 Part 4 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 4) senior civil service positions;
units.label: Point 4 Part 4 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 5) junior civil service positions.
units.label: Point 5 Part 4 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 5. Civil service positions in the ‘managers’ and ‘assistants (advisers)’ categories are divided into the highest, principal and leading groups of civil service positions in accordance with the Register of State Civil Service Positions of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 6. Civil service positions in the ‘specialists’ category are divided into the highest, principal, leading and senior groups of civil service positions in accordance with the Register of State Civil Service Positions of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 7. Civil service positions in the ‘support specialists’ category are divided into the principal, leading, senior and junior groups of civil service positions in accordance with the Register of State Civil Service Positions of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Classification of civil service positions
units.text: 8. The correspondence between civil service positions of the City of Moscow and federal state civil service positions is determined in accordance with a federal law or a decree of the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 7. Register of state civil service positions of the City of Moscow
units.text: Article 7. Register of state civil service positions of the City of Moscow
units.label: Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Register of state civil service positions of the City of Moscow
units.text: 1. Civil service positions classified by state body, category and group form the Register of State Civil Service Positions of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Register of state civil service positions of the City of Moscow
units.text: 2. The Register of State Civil Service Positions of the City of Moscow is approved by a decree of the Mayor of Moscow in accordance with this Law and the structure of state bodies, and taking account of the Register of Federal State Civil Service Positions.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Register of state civil service positions of the City of Moscow
units.text: 3. This part was repealed with effect from 11 July 2011 by Law of the City of Moscow of 8 June 2011 No. 24.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 8. Civil service class ranks
units.text: Article 8. Civil service class ranks
units.label: Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Civil service class ranks
units.text: 1. Civil service class ranks are conferred on civil servants in accordance with federal legislation and this Article.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Civil service class ranks
units.text: 2. This part was repealed with effect from 29 April 2023 by Law of the City of Moscow of 19 April 2023 No. 10.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Civil service class ranks
units.text: 3. This part was repealed with effect from 24 December 2011 by Law of the City of Moscow of 30 November 2011 No. 57.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 8
